title: Munitions Reserves after the roll
description: Letnev's Munitions Reserves used to be paid blind at the start of each combat round (before any dice existed) and then re-rolled every miss automatically. From rules version 2 the Letnev player sees the fleet's roll first and then decides: spend 2 trade goods to re-roll all missed dice, choose which missed dice to re-roll one by one, or keep the roll for free. Older games keep the old flow. Mocked fixtures (a Letnev attacker with three cruisers hitting on 7).

shots.heading: The offer, with the dice in view
shots.caption: Faces 3, 9 and 1 against 7: one hit and two misses are shown. The first button spends 2 trade goods (5 to 3) and re-rolls both misses; the second lets you pick which dice to re-roll; Don't use it keeps the roll and costs nothing.

shots.heading: One miss: no choosing
shots.caption: With a single missed die the choose-dice button is not offered; re-rolling it or declining are the only answers.

shots.heading: Choosing dice: one question per die
shots.caption: After choosing which dice, each die is asked about on the usual re-roll card with the whole roll shown (the rule bot only redraws misses). The 2 trade goods were already paid when this question is asked.
